title: EduRiskX: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework with F-Logic Reasoning for Early Academic Risk Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.26107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting students' academic risk in online education is crucial for enabling timely interventions that can improve retention and learning outcomes. However, existing models often suffer from limited early detection capability and insufficient interpretability, leading to a "black-box" trust crisis that hinders their adoption in real-world pedagogical settings. To address these challenges, we propose EduRiskX, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates a temporal Transformer-based predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning. The neural component models longitudinal student activity sequences using temporal attention, class-weighted loss, and dynamic weekly truncation. Acting as a data-driven expert system, an F-Logic rule base -- grounded in established educational theories (Engagement Theory and Student Integration Model) to mimic the diagnostic logic of human educators -- is constructed exclusively from the training data. translated_abstract: 在在线教育中预测学生的学业风险对于及时干预以提高保留率和学习成果至关重要。然而，现有模型通常存在早期检测能力有限和可解释性不足的问题，导致“黑箱”信任危机，阻碍了它们在实际教学环境中的应用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EduRiskX，一种神经符号框架，将基于时间Transformer的预测器与F-Logic符号推理相结合。神经组件使用时间注意力、类加权损失和动态周截断来建模纵向学生活动序列。作为一个数据驱动的专家系统，一个基于F-Logic规则库——以既定的教育理论（参与理论和学生整合模型）为基础，模拟人类教育者的诊断逻辑——完全从训练数据中构建。神经风险...
tldr: EduRiskX通过结合时间Transformer和F-Logic规则推理，在提升早期学业风险检测能力的同时增强了模型的可解释性。
en_tdlr: EduRiskX enhances early academic risk detection and interpretability by integrating a temporal Transformer with F-Logic rule-based reasoning.
